trials.title: A Study to Assess Nomlabofusp in Adolescents and Children With Friedreich's Ataxia
trials.why: Review of Cohort 1 data facilitated direct enrollment into open label study and eliminate pause in study drug administration between PK study and open label study.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Number of AEs, TEAEs, related TEAEs, Grade 3/4 TEAEs, and SAEs
Change from baseline in electrocardiogram (ECG) parameter - heart rate (HR)
Change from baseline in electrocardiogram (ECG) parameter - PR interval
Change from baseline in electrocardiogram (ECG) parameter - QRS complex
Change from baseline in electrocardiogram (ECG) parameter - QT interval

reasons: one of only 2 trials at this company

signals.text: Enrollment finalized at 18 vs original target 18 (0%)
Terminated, reason: Review of Cohort 1 data facilitated direct enrollment into open label study and eliminate pause in study drug administration between PK study and open label study. [enrollment]
signals.read: Could not enroll. Execution or market-size problem rather than a drug problem, but it still removes the asset.

trials.commentary: Ph 1, randomized, double-blind. Enrolled 18. Started Dec 2024, primary completion Apr 2025. Stopped: Review of Cohort 1 data facilitated direct enrollment into open label study and eliminate pause in study drug administration between PK study and open label study. Record history not collected yet; comparisons are vs first seen.

trials.title: A Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of Subcutaneous Nomlabofusp in Subjects With Friedreich's Ataxia

primaryOutcomes.measure: Change from baseline in Upright Stability Score (USS) subscale E of modified Friedreich's Ataxia Rating Scale (mFARS) at Week 72 (Region-specific)
Change from baseline in the total modified Friedreich's Ataxia Rating Scale (mFARS) at Week 72 (Region-specific)

reasons: one of only 2 trials at this company
trials.commentary: Ph 3, randomized, double-blind. Targeting 150 patients. Started Oct 2026, primary completion Jul 2029. Record history not collected yet; comparisons are vs first seen.

trials.title: An Open-Label Study of CTI-1601 in Subjects With Friedreich's Ataxia

primaryOutcomes.measure: Number of subjects with treatment-emergent adverse events (TEAEs) by System Organ Class (SOC), Preferred Term (PT) and Maximum Severity
Change from baseline in electrocardiogram (ECG) parameters including, but not limited to, HR, RR interval, PR interval, QRS duration, QT interval, and QTcF interval
Change from baseline in left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF)
Change from baseline in left ventricular end-diastolic volume (LVEDV)
Number of subjects with any suicidal ideation or behavior (Categories 1-10) of the Columbia Suicide Severity Rating Scale (C-SSRS)

Change from baseline at each collection timepoint in tissue frataxin concentrations normalized to total protein observed in buccal cells collected from cheek swabs and skin cells collected from skin punch biopsies

reasons: one of only 2 trials at this company
trials.commentary: Ph 2, open-label. Targeting 85 patients. Started Jan 2024, primary completion Jan 2027. Record history not collected yet; comparisons are vs first seen.
